behaviour_groups.title: phase, docs and evidence agents can return blocked with a reason, and the build's `attempt` reruns a red checkpoint live (spec, user flows 1 and 2)
throwaway worktrees are named under `tmp/` and removed, `cleanup_check.py --detached` judges them, and stale private host refs are pruned (spec, user flows 3 and 5)
the per-fix regression check counts only what reproduces on the branch tip (spec, user flow 4)
the plan, cleanup and run skills carry the head's side (spec, user flow 6)
